message: So, I have this friend who tends to panic at the mere mention of fire safety. 😅 But honestly, I've learned a thing or two about keeping my home safe from flames, and it’s not as daunting as it seems! The U.S. Fire Administration has some really helpful tips to make sure we’re all prepared without getting overwhelmed. Remember, it’s about being informed and ready, not scared. What’s one safety tip you swear by?
